goal: Allow running a transaction index alongside block pruning to look up transactions on pruned nodes
Return candidate block hashes in RPC and REST errors when a requested transaction resides in a pruned block
agreement: Widespread concept support across multiple reviewers (ajtowns, arejula27, l0rinc, optout21)
Support after testing reindex on a pruned node and querying recent transactions (optout21)
Unaddressed objection: multi-transaction proof requests fail during reorgs without reporting hashes (l0rinc)
Additional open questions on test coverage, PSBT handling, and error response details (arejula27, fjahr, l0rinc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it resolves multiple long-standing feature requests to enable txindex with block pruning
Significantly expands the utility of pruned nodes by allowing full transaction indexing without full chains

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it provides structured error data with pruned block hashes for RPC and REST endpoints
Enables callers to programmatically identify and retrieve missing blocks via getblockfrompeer
